name: Niseko-Shakotan-Otaru Kaigan Quasi-National Park
nameJa: ニセコ積丹小樽海岸国定公園
aliases: ニセコ積丹小樽海岸国定公園
description: Quasi-national park joining the Niseko volcano group, the Shakotan Peninsula sea cliffs and the Otaru coast west of Sapporo.
notes: Managed by Hokkaido. The Shakotan coastal road and Niseko's summer hiking are the draws.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
